author: Informal_Librarian_7
body: Nope, putting it plain and simple. You need more bulk, most of what you have there is endless setup stuff. As youre t9 srop every summoning scroll you have today and tomorrow and farm fools. They drops the headpiece with the highest ward stat, the arisen kings crown. Then farm high ward armour and leggings. Get a shield on there, thats the easiest way to increase survival time. Hopefully you get one from mammon but once you hit t10 the arisen shield will automatically be better. Get some immortal rings as well as they increase health a lot. Thats the most basic way to survive. Towers become easier the more you do them.

author: 1HappyCat8
body: Get a 1 handed ward staff (arisen king sceptre, from king meliodas) and a ward shield (the T9 griffin one). 16k ward isn't enough. It wasn't until having 50k ward before I felt a bit safe. That might be harder as a T9 tho.
